A job (Job F) owned by a standard user exists in the system.

steps.action: Log in as a super user.
steps.expected_result: Super user is logged in and can access all jobs.

steps.action: Select Job F (owned by another user) and issue the re-start command.
steps.expected_result: Job F is re-started successfully by the super user.

test_cases.title: Super User Resume Any Stopped Job
preconditions: A super user exists.
A job (Job H) owned by a standard user exists in a stopped state.

steps.action: Log in as a super user.
steps.expected_result: Super user is logged in and locates Job H (owned by another user) in a stopped state.

steps.action: Select Job H and issue the resume command.
steps.expected_result: Job H is successfully resumed by the super user.

test_cases.title: Non-Super User Attempting to Resume Another User's Stopped Job is Denied Permission
preconditions: The job is in a stopped state.
The logged-in user is a non-super user.
The stopped job is owned by another user.

steps.action: Log in as a regular non-super user who does not own the target stopped job.
steps.expected_result: Non-super user is authenticated and logged in.

steps.action: Attempt to issue the command to resume the stopped job owned by another user.
steps.expected_result: Permission is denied and the job is not resumed.
